method: **To make Paneer:** Bring 2 liters of milk to a boil. Add 5 tsp of vinegar and stir until the milk curdles. Strain through a clean cloth to separate the whey. Squeeze out the excess water to get fresh paneer.
Crumble or grate the fresh paneer.
Heat oil in a pan. Add mustard seeds and cumin seeds, and let them splutter.
Add the finely chopped onions and sauté until they turn translucent.
Add turmeric powder, salt, and garam masala, and mix well.
Add chopped green chilies and sauté.
Add the crumbled paneer and mix thoroughly.
Add the finely chopped tomatoes and ginger (cut into thin strips).
Sauté until the tomatoes are cooked soft.
Finally, garnish with chopped coriander leaves and curry leaves.
Note: This can also be made using store-bought paneer.
